response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with genuine geospatial/GIS depth (GISCollective, Green Map, FOSS4G talk) and proven low-latency, high-throughput backend work at Sociomantic using D with async I/O, fibers, and caching — which maps conceptually to the routing tiling problem space. However, the role's core requirement is modern C++ (or Rust) systems development, and his only C/C++ exposure is a six-month stint at National Instruments over a decade ago; there is no Rust experience and no navigation guidance/routing pipeline work. His recent decade has been predominantly TypeScript/Node.js full-stack and web-oriented. He fits the 'willing to work beyond current expertise' and data/testing rigor criteria well, but would need substantial ramp-up on the primary language and distributed systems fundamentals, making him a borderline candidate rather than a clear match.
strengths: Deep, hands-on geospatial/GIS platform experience (GISCollective, Green Map)
Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems work (millions of req/s at Sociomantic)
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, Linux/DevOps breadth
concerns: Modern C++ experience is minimal and over 10 years stale; no Rust
No navigation/routing pipeline or map-tiling domain experience
Recent roles are web/full-stack TypeScript, not systems engineering
